column8:
Lea: Sadly I don't know of an alternative to the Technorati ranking system. Blogs themselves are on their way down as an object of care and hence companies are not investing in dedicated tools and metrics. Perhaps competitive intelligence systems, like Compete or SimilarWeb, might provide an alternative. Neither ranks only blogs, but we can identify our blog of interest and a few competitors and then use site rank as a proxy. Not a good one, but something.

Avinash.
